svg.text: What makes ingestion useful for RAG?
Keep small, traceable pieces of evidence that the vector and keyword indexes can search.
Chunking uses all non-blank pages, including narrative pages outside the KPI extraction subset.
A SAVED CHUNK · actual inspection-artifact metadata
The Flutter upload enables artifact saving.
INDEXING HANDOFF · implemented in the ingestion orchestrator
Same enriched chunks → OpenAI embeddings + Chroma dense index, and LangChain BM25 sparse index
